{{dablink|For other uses of the word "blue," see [[Blue]].}}
'''Bluewort''' is an [[herbs|herb]] that can be found in the [[Two Rivers]] region and in [[Tear]]. It can be brewed as a tea and administered to ease a queasy stomach.{{ref/book|3|48}} Bluewort also can be used as a dye, producing a purple-blue color.{{ref/book|7|23}}
